Description.Default: Base URL of the Dataverse environment, without trailing slash. The flow AdoptaENApplySettings writes it when the settings are saved in Adopta Admin; it can also be set at import in deploymentSettings.json, so the agents work from their first publish. The Adopta agent uses it to read settings and communications.
